acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Route /[locale]/marble/[slug] renders marble detail page - Server Component for SEO and performance, static generation with generateStaticParams, returns 404 for invalid slugs, proper meta tags for SEO
Hero image displays marble texture in high quality - Uses /public/textures/{slug}/hero.jpg or preview.jpg fallback, full-width hero section, responsive sizing via next/image, optional parallax effect
Marble name displays in Cormorant Garamond typography - Uses font-display class, multilingual name resolved for current locale, elegant text hierarchy per UX spec
Origin story and characteristics description displayed - Multilingual description resolved for current locale, rich prose section with proper typography, sufficient spacing per UX spec
Technical specifications section shows: country of origin with optional flag icon, available finishes as visual chips/badges, density indicator (~2,700 kg/m³), each spec clearly labeled
Price range indicator visible - Shows From X € to Y € based on min/max cube sizes, calculated from basePricePerCm3 × volume × finish modifiers, locale-aware currency formatting, positioned near CTA

Create My Cube CTA button is prominent - Gold accent color (#C9A962) per UX spec, navigates to /[locale]/configurator?marble={slug}, prominent position (sticky on scroll or fixed), hover state with subtle animation
Page follows Carrara Pure theme (light mode) - White background (#FFFFFF) with surface accents (#F8F8F8), elegant spacing and visual hierarchy, consistent with gallery page styling
Images zoomable via lightbox on click - Click hero image opens lightbox/modal, close via click outside, X button, or Escape key, optional gallery of additional images, smooth animations

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR31: Users can view detailed product pages for each marble type. FR32: Product pages display marble specifications (origin, characteristics, available finishes). FR33: Product pages show high-quality imagery of marble texture and sample cubes.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Background: Pure White #FFFFFF, Surface: Soft Gray #F8F8F8, Border: Light Gray #E5E5E5, Primary Text: Deep Black #1A1A1A, Gold Accent for CTAs: #C9A962. Typography: Cormorant Garamond for display, Inter for body.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Button hierarchy: Primary uses Gold (#C9A962) solid. Hover animations: scale-[1.02] with shadow-lg. Modal patterns: Blur + dark overlay (50% opacity), fade + subtle scale animation.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.section: ADR-005: Server Actions over API Routes
doc.snippet: Use Server Components for data fetching (SEO, performance). Static generation with generateStaticParams for marble detail pages. Image optimization via next/image.

doc.title: Epic 2 Tech Spec
doc.snippet: AC-2.5.1 through AC-2.5.8: Hero image, Cormorant typography, origin story, technical specs, price range, CTA button, Carrara Pure theme, zoomable images.

doc.title: Epics
doc.snippet: Route: src/app/[locale]/marble/[slug]/page.tsx. CTA navigates to /configurator?marble={slug}. Dynamic route with generateStaticParams for static generation.

constraints.constraint: Page must be a Server Component for SEO and performance optimization
Use generateStaticParams to pre-render all marble detail pages at build time
All images must use next/image for automatic optimization and lazy loading
Carrara Pure theme: White background #FFFFFF, surface #F8F8F8, text #1A1A1A, gold accent #C9A962
Typography: Cormorant Garamond for headlines (font-display), Inter for body (font-body)
Modal patterns: Close via X button, Escape key, and click outside. Focus auto-focus first interactive element.
Image paths: /public/textures/{slug}/hero.jpg for hero, preview.jpg as fallback
Follow component organization pattern: src/components/marble/ with index.ts exports
Page load time must be under 2 seconds for non-3D pages
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance for all content

interface.name: getMarbleBySlug
interface.signature: getMarbleBySlug(slug: string, locale: string): Promise<MarbleDetailLocalized | null>
interface.description: Fetches single marble by slug with finishes, resolves multilingual fields to locale

interface.name: MarbleDetailLocalized
interface.signature: interface MarbleDetailLocalized extends MarbleLocalized { priceRange: { min: number; max: number }; }
interface.description: Extended marble type with calculated price range for detail page

interface.name: calculatePriceRange
interface.signature: calculatePriceRange(marble: MarbleLocalized): { min: number; max: number }
interface.description: Calculates price range from min cube (5×5×5) to max cube (100×100×100) with finish modifiers

interface.name: generateStaticParams
interface.signature: generateStaticParams(): Promise<{ locale: string; slug: string }[]>
interface.description: Returns all marble slugs for all locales for static generation

interface.name: generateMetadata
interface.description: Generates SEO metadata with marble name, description, and OG image

tests.standards: Testing follows the project patterns established in Epic 1-2. Use Vitest for unit tests and Playwright for E2E tests. Server Components should be tested via integration/E2E. Client Components can use component testing with React Testing Library. Build verification: npm run build must pass, TypeScript compilation via npx tsc --noEmit must succeed.

locations.location: tests/unit/ - Unit tests for utility functions (calculatePriceRange)
tests/components/ - Component tests for MarbleHero, MarbleSpecs, MarbleCTA, ImageLightbox
tests/e2e/ - E2E tests for full marble detail page flow
